page.content:
Rite in Regan's bedroom that kills Merrin and costs Karras.

How The exorcism connects

  • Location: MacNeil house — The exorcism is performed in Regan's bedroom.
  • Character: Father Lankester Merrin — Merrin leads the formal rite.
  • Character: Father Damien Karras — Karras assists and then finishes the rite.
  • Creator: Burke Dennings — Burke's death on the steps is what the possession first costs outsiders.

What is The exorcism?

The exorcism is the bedroom rite of holy water, the Roman ritual, and Karras's final challenge that ends on the Georgetown steps.

Key threads lead to MacNeil house, Father Lankester Merrin, Father Damien Karras and Burke Dennings.
